english.title: Use fire hydrant for purpose other than fire fighting or authorised purpose
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a fire hydrant otherwise than for the purposes of fire-fighting, for any other purposes of a fire and rescue authority or for a purpose authorised by the water undertaker or other person to whom the hydrant belonged
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42(6) and (8) of the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant, used a fire hydrant otherwise than for the purposes of fire-fighting, for any other purposes of a fire and rescue authority or for a purpose authorised by the water undertaker or other person to whom the hydrant belonged.
